provenance: All records, IDs, paths, timestamps, names, public text and private sentinel text are synthetic. No captured personal transcript, account data, provider runtime test or paid model call is used.
schemas: codex-rs/protocol/src/items.rs: PascalCase TurnItem and AgentMessageContent, CommandExecution and McpToolCall
codex-rs/state/src/extract.rs and thread-store/src/local/helpers.rs: native legacy naming and Guardian default policy

fixtures.native.mjs: Synthetic schema builders; paginated ordinal starts at inherited exclusive end; header is included in byte cutoffs. SQLite schema contains the selected projection of real threads columns, not a copied native database.
fixtures.codex-adapter.test.mjs: Exact fixture oracles for metadata, text, roles/statuses, ancestry, privacy sentinels, WAL, immutable source tree, malformed/partial/unsupported input and caps.
fixtures.offline.mjs: Test-only process/network guard; no provider executable may be invoked.

runtime: Node >=22.15, built-in SQLite/private DB+WAL copy, streaming zstd. SQLite WAL behavior: https://sqlite.org/wal.html#read_only_databases
